name: Dal Baati Churma
ingredients: Mixed lentils (chana dal, toor dal, moong dal, urad dal)
instructions: 1. Knead a stiff dough with wheat flour, semolina, ghee, and salt, then shape into small balls and bake until golden brown.
2. Boil the mixed lentils with turmeric and salt until soft, then temper with ghee, cumin, mustard seeds, asafoetida, ginger, and chili.
3. Prepare churma by frying coarsely ground wheat balls, crushing them, and mixing with powdered jaggery, ghee, and nuts.
4. Serve the baati by dipping them generously in melted ghee, accompanied by the hot dal and the sweet churma.
description: Dal Baati Churma is the iconic culinary signature of Rajasthan. Traditionally prepared during festive occasions and gatherings, it represents the rustic, high-energy diet of the desert region. It is highly nutritious, filling, and deeply embedded in the cultural heritage of the Marwar and Mewar regions.
